name: team_planning_timeline
description: Get one path of a Team Planning plan the caller is in, from the baseline to a scenario, laid out along the calendar. columns are the steps, root first, each with its name, period and alternative_ids: the 'instead' scenarios that could stand in that step's place. next_ids are the 'then' scenarios after the last step. blocks are units, one per unit across the columns it lives in (a rename or a one-to-one succession keeps the block), with units per column (null where it doesn't live), continues_from_ids for a split or merge, and lane_ids in order. A lane is one head: a person while they are on the map, a position's bars while it stands empty, a backfill in the lane of the person it replaces, and the first hire into a position in that position's lane. Bars give the columns a place is held (from and to are column indexes); a unit_id of null is Unassigned, listed in unassigned_lane_ids. A person's bar carries shares, their share of their time in that place in each of its columns, counting every place they hold as the map does. moves name the units a person left and joined after a column (crossing is "out" when they leave the units a scoped plan covers and "in" when they join them), and departures the column they leave in, with its backfill. positions are keyed by id, each as it stands in the last column it appears in. `names` maps every person id to a name; a forgotten person reads as "Former member". Refused, as an unknown plan, unless the caller is a member.

scenario_id.description: The last step, or the plan's id for the baseline alone.
